question: Tell me the owner id and last name of the owner who spent the most on treatments of his or her dogs.
reference_sql: SELECT T1.owner_id ,  T1.last_name FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id JOIN Treatments AS T3 ON T2.dog_id  =  T3.dog_id GROUP BY T1.owner_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

final.sql:
SELECT o.owner_id, o.last_name
FROM Owners o
JOIN Dogs d ON o.owner_id = d.owner_id
JOIN Treatments t ON d.dog_id = t.dog_id
GROUP BY o.owner_id, o.last_name
ORDER BY SUM(t.cost_of_treatment) DESC
LIMIT 1
